entity.name: Agenty Analytics Pvt. Ltd.
entity.description: Agenty Analytics builds and maintains Shortener.dev, an open-source URL shortener with click analytics. Funding pays for maintainer time, security work, abuse and spam prevention on the hosted service, and the infrastructure behind the free tier.

projects.name: Shortener.dev
projects.description: An open-source URL shortener with click analytics, custom back-halves, UTM tracking, password-protected links, and geo and app targeting, built on Cloudflare Workers. It includes a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, a dashboard, a browser extension and a marketing site, and can be self-hosted or used at shortener.dev.

channels.description: Monthly or one-time sponsorship through GitHub Sponsors.
Monthly, yearly or one-time contributions through Open Collective, with invoices and a public ledger.
